facts.fact: The World Bank's BRIDGE project information document says that in 2019 Nigeria 'published' the ten-year National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy (NDEPS) 2020-2030; it names no adopting act or body, so the source's verb gives publication only.
facts.system: National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy 2020-2030

facts.fact: The same document describes the NDEPS as a ten-year strategy for 2020-2030 that Nigeria published, and speaks of it in the present as the framework the federal government works under; the document gives no as-at date for this beyond its own 18 August 2025 preparation date, which is used here.
facts.system: National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy 2020-2030

facts.fact: The document says that under the 2023 National Strategic Blueprint the federal government aims to cover at least 80 percent of the population by the end of 2027, a dated target with no cost stated.

systems.system: National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy (NDEPS) 2020-2030
systems.country_label: National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy (designated policy maker of the sector)

systems.system: National Strategic Blueprint 'Accelerating our collective prosperity through technical efficiency' (2023)
Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth (BRIDGE, P508383)
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy (implementing agency); World Bank financing

note: The NDEPS and the 2023 Blueprint are named without any description of whether they cover both economy and state, so their class is left empty; the document's verb for the NDEPS is 'published'.
